A rental shouldn't just look like a home. It should work like one.

HOMtology looks beyond appearance to the practical realities of everyday living.

The problem

A listing can tell you what a home has.

A rental may have a kitchen, a bedroom, storage and a workspace — yet still fall short in everyday use.

Photos show appearance. Amenity lists show what is present. Reviews reflect individual experiences.

But none of them consistently answer a simple question:
Is this home actually functional for the person living in it?
Functionality

Functionality goes beyond having the right amenities.

HOMtology looks at the home through the lens of everyday use. Not simply whether something is present — but whether the home, as a whole, supports the practical needs of living.

PresentSomething exists in the property.
UsableIt can be used in a practical way.
FunctionalThe home supports real everyday living.
Having something ≠ being able to use it well.
Beyond appearance

Beautiful doesn't always mean functional.

A home can photograph beautifully and still create small frustrations every day. HOMtology is being developed to look beyond appearance.

Introducing HOMtology

A standard built around real life.

HOMtology is an independent initiative developing a structured standard for evaluating the functionality of rental homes.

The framework is currently in its research and pilot phase and is being tested with property owners and managers.

We don't rate luxury.A more expensive home is not automatically a more functional home.
We don't rate style.HOMtology is not an interior-design award.
We focus on functionality.How well the home supports the practical realities of everyday living.

How it works

A simple four-step pilot process.

STEP 01

Apply

Tell us about your rental property.

STEP 02

Share your experience

Answer a short set of questions about the property and the people who rent it.

STEP 03

Pilot assessment

Selected properties are evaluated using the developing HOMtology framework.

STEP 04

Receive feedback

We share initial findings about the property's functionality and learn from your experience.

Research

Built from real homes, not assumptions.

Before establishing a standard, we want to understand how rental homes actually function across different markets, property types and rental models.

That's why we're working directly with owners and property managers during the development phase.

Who we're looking for

Owners and managers who care about how a home actually works.

Property owners & independent landlords

Apartments, houses and villas used for short-, mid- or long-term rentals.

Property managers & management companies

Professionals overseeing one or multiple rental homes and interested in improving practical living experience.

About HOMtology

A clearer standard for how homes actually work.

HOMtology is an independent initiative developing a functionality standard for rental homes.

Our goal is to create a clearer, more consistent way to understand whether a rental property supports the practical realities of everyday living.

HOMtology does not currently issue formal certifications. Pilot assessments are conducted for research and framework-development purposes.

A rental shouldn't just look like a home. It should work like one.
